about: Server (9 instances): A* search state of a navcloud path request, created by navcloud::PathfindingSystem::ProcessRequests (macOS: placement PathInternalComponent::PathInternalComponent(), then start/goal TilePos from FindValidTilePos) and advanced by ProcessSearches. Members: start and goal navcloud::TilePos (24 bytes each), an open-list ls::BinaryHeap<navcloud::NodeHeap>, a DynamicArray<navcloud::NodeFull> of visited nodes (36 bytes), and a HashMap<navcloud::TilePos, int32> from tile to node index. The heap and the tile->node map are written out member by member (their key/element types are structs of this file).
